text:
I fixed `add()` in `calc.py` so it returns `a + b` instead of `a - b`, and committed the change. I didn't run the tests. The shell asked for approval on the test command, and I didn't retry it. Reading `tests/test_calc.py` by hand, both assertions (`add(2, 3) == 5` and `add(-1, 1) == 0`) hold with the new code.

I left the test file untouched. The recalled episodic note was withheld as injection-shaped, so I ignored it.
